cases.input: Rename a canonical domain concept across persistence, API, events, tests and documentation while preserving compatibility with a temporary external alias and a verified rollback path.
requiredBehaviors: map the canonical concept and all affected representations
classify compatibility and migration order before implementation
verify invariants aliases rollback and cross-surface consistency
forbiddenBehaviors: treat passing type checks as proof of semantic equivalence
skillAnchors: Grüne CI allein beweist keine semantische Gleichwertigkeit

cases.input: Move an entity boundary while an external integration still uses the legacy identifier and a destructive migration would otherwise be tempting.
requiredBehaviors: classify the boundary move as requiring explicit decision authority
preserve a scoped compatibility alias for the external integration
plan coexistence rollback and removal criteria
forbiddenBehaviors: duplicate the invariant in both old and new boundaries indefinitely
skillAnchors: Externe Aliase bleiben auf benannte Grenzen beschränkt
Koexistenz, Adapter, Backfill, Rollback und Entfernungskriterien

cases.input: A patch changes a database column and API field independently, leaves events and fixtures untouched, and declares success because CI is green.
requiredBehaviors: identify event fixture and documentation drift
require semantic validation beyond green CI
forbiddenBehaviors: assume green CI proves the domain model remains correct
